messages.content: Synthetic source: DOC-WELCOME-2026, section 1: People Operations owns the new-hire welcome guide. Who should I contact about an error in that guide?
Contact People Operations, the documented owner of the welcome guide. [DOC-WELCOME-2026, section 1] This does not establish who approves application access.
Synthetic source: DOC-GLOSSARY-2026, section 3: A sandbox is a non-production environment used for testing. Does sandbox mean I automatically have permission to use it?
The source defines sandbox as a non-production testing environment. It does not say that access is automatic. Ask the environment owner for the access procedure. [DOC-GLOSSARY-2026, section 3]
Synthetic source: DOC-WRITING-2026, section 2: Each procedure must name its owner and last review date. I found a procedure without either. How should I report it?

Draft a documentation follow-up that identifies the procedure and asks for its owner and last review date. Do not invent those fields or mark it current until they are confirmed. [DOC-WRITING-2026, section 2]
